sourceAtlasWorkflow: Sacred art — full visual curator atlas
method: Original complete-image embedded preview examined on a four-column contact sheet; inspect mobile legibility as well as naturalistic modelling, painting quality, subject dignity, coherence of light and expressive force.
mixedMediaRule: Historic devotional objects may be retained in their proper category, not silently equated to oil paintings.
notes: An image may be a fine secondary narrative illustration even when too weak for a major feast's primary hero.
All existing user/editorial choices and refusals are preserved, including historical conflicting choices for audit.
This is a substantial first visual screening batch, not a complete judgement of the 266-original collection.
Any picture may have a different placement role (hero, small saint card, Bible illustration) depending on full-composition legibility.

artworks.title: The Immaculate Conception
artworks.specificReason: Murillo's Immaculate Conception has a clean luminous silhouette and natural figures.

artworks.title: Saints Peter and Paul
artworks.specificReason: Manfredi portraits Peter and Paul together, with compelling chiaroscuro; iconographically apt for June 29.

artworks.title: Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.specificReason: Rich naturalistic nativity group and discernible infant focus; strong Christmas alternative already acquired.

artworks.title: The Denial of Saint Peter
artworks.specificReason: Caravaggio Denial of Peter: exceptionally focused chiaroscuro and gesture; do not conflate with a solemn apostle portrait.

artworks.title: Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.specificReason: Warm chiaroscuro, clear group of kneeling shepherds and Christ Child; strong historical Christmas selection.

artworks.title: The Supper at Emmaus
artworks.specificReason: Velázquez Emmaus is masterly and clear in three faces, but should not be mislabeled as the Last Supper of Holy Thursday.

artworks.title: Saint Benedict
artworks.specificReason: Zurbarán Benedict is distinguished by powerful dark habit figure, restrained posture, serious landscape.

artworks.title: Saint Lucy
artworks.specificReason: Zurbarán's Saint Lucy portrait has excellent contrast and credible naturalistic modelling.

artworks.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.specificReason: Navez massacre paints human grief effectively; depict Holy Innocents only as subject of massacre, not an artificial saint portrait.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.specificReason: Gandolfi Holy Family is painterly, strong concentrated figures; suitable Joseph and Holy Family contextual use.

artworks.title: The Penitent Magdalen
artworks.specificReason: La Tour's Magdalene works very well as a small, focused devotional portrait, but not a feast-specific biblical scene.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds

artworks.title: Saint Michael the Archangel

artworks.title: The Miraculous Draught of Fishes

artworks.title: The Virgin Adoring the Host

artworks.title: The Annunciation

artworks.title: The Denial of Saint Peter
